infobox: American Airlines is the world's largest carrier by fleet size, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, with its main hub at Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport. As a U.S. carrier, American is bound by Department of Transportation (DOT) rules on flight delays, cancellations, and denied boarding, as well as by the Montreal Convention for lost or damaged baggage on international itineraries. Passengers who are involuntarily bumped from an oversold domestic flight are entitled to cash compensation of up to $1,550, and refunds are owed whenever a flight is cancelled or significantly changed and the passenger chooses not to travel. Complaints that go unresolved with the airline can be escalated to the DOT's Aviation Consumer Protection Division.

If Delta fails to resolve a complaint directly, travelers can escalate the matter to the DOT.

Unresolved complaints can be escalated to the DOT.
